.max-width-70 { max-width: 70%; } .animate-message { animation: slideInUp 0.3s ease-out; } @keyframes slideInUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } /* Scroll personalizado para el área del chat */ .overflow-auto::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; } .overflow-auto::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #f1f1f1; border-radius: 10px; } .overflow-auto::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #c1c1c1; border-radius: 10px; } .overflow-auto::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #a8a8a8; } /* Efectos hover en los bubbles */ .bg-light:hover { background-color: #f8f9fa !important; transform: translateY(-1px); transition: all 0.2s ease; } .bg-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); transition: all 0.2s ease; } /* Responsive adjustments */ @media (max-width: 768px) { .max-width-70 { max-width: 85%; } .card { height: 500px !important; } .overflow-auto { max-height: calc(500px - 140px) !important; } }
